turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on some and any?
turns.tutor:
Some and any come up when we order food, so let us start with ordering in a cafe.
Let me think out loud. I want juice. Just "Juice!" is too short and not polite. So I start with "Can I have", then the drink, then please: "Can I have some juice, please?"
Rule: to order, say "Can I have ..., please?" or "I'd like ..., please."
Right: I'd like a cake, please. Wrong: Give me cake.
Your turn. You want a cup of hot chocolate. Write what you say to the waiter.
